# Cross map MPQ name dictionary
# Harvested 2026-07-31 from the 19 of 52 scanned map files whose own MPQ listfile named
# every single block table entry, no standard name probe and no other help. One name per
# line, plain war3map internal paths, mostly under war3mapImported for custom assets.
# Feed this list to MpqArchive.AddFileNames alongside Wc3.Model.StandardMapFileNames.All
# to recover more names from a protected archive whose own listfile was stripped or
# curated down to a few decoy entries. An MPQ hashes a name rather than storing it, so a
# name is either an exact match or it does not resolve, there is no partial credit.
# Measured effect, see tests/Wc3.Tests/ProtectedMapNameRecoveryTests.cs and the report it
# writes to %TEMP%\wc3ctl-mpq-name-recovery.md. Across 33 protected maps in that scan this
# dictionary alone named 4125 entries the standard probe did not, concentrated in a few
# map genres (LOD family, Angel Samurai family, Naruto family) whose imported asset packs
# clearly circulate between authors, and close to nothing on others. Regenerate by rerunning
# that test, it is deterministic given the same healthy maps.
